changelog: Introducing BOARD CHIPS — the plaque your units stand on is now a collectible cosmetic. 16 chips span five rarity tiers, from Oak, Walnut and Mahogany up through Bronze, Silver and Polished Steel to a gleaming Gold and a see-through Crystal. Win them as run rewards: every finished run rolls a chip (a voluntary retreat doesn't count), and the odds of a higher tier scale with BOTH how far you got and your Ascension — a first-node loss at Ascension 0 only ever drops common, while a win at the Ascension ceiling makes legendary genuinely likely. Roll a chip you already own and nothing happens; roll a new one and it's yours. Equip one chip for YOUR units and a different one for the ENEMY, independently, from Settings -> Board Chips. Faction is still shown by the unit glow, so the board stays just as readable.
